decisions.statement: The unit running the sampler is simple rather than a timer.
Repeated starts are counted over no window.
A round of samples landing each minute is what says this sampler is working.
The window holds three rounds, so two missed rounds are not yet broken.
The readouts this sampler keeps show the last reading kept when the sampler dies.
No secret is needed, since nothing here is carried off the workstation.

definition: the service taking the workstation's processor and memory readings every five seconds
